description: Listings: facets, languages, countries, categories, sources, methods, diets, diet_review, ingredients, certifications. facets has every filter value; languages, countries, categories, sources and methods say what exists and how many recipes; diets lists the dietary categories with their definitions, coverage and limits; diet_review lists published claims held back because the recipe contradicts them; ingredients looks up ingredient names (q); certifications lists real certificates (today only fictional examples) and recipe claims with basis certified.
